reentrancy-balance:PTSleeveEthExecutor.reason: All entry points are onlyOps + nonReentrant (ops = owner-set keeper EOA; setOps onlyOwner). Executors hold funds only transiently within one call and measure each leg by balance delta; venue targets are owner-set or immutable. Slither cannot model the guard — same class accepted for SUSD3Strategy (2026-10-05).

accepted.reentrancy-balance:PTSleeveStrategy: completeInbound measures the inbound mint as a balance delta after receiveMessage. The CCTP transmitter mints only to this contract (mintRecipient fixed in our return transfers) and completeInbound is nonReentrant, so the 'stale balance' path is not reachable; the balance read is the intended measurement. Slither rates it High impact but cannot model the guard/recipient. Flagged 2026-10-05 while remediating t_698f42c2.
accepted.reentrancy-balance:PYDFunder: The swap target is an owner-set swapper (trusted config, like the baselined funding source); nonReentrant blocks re-entry into topUp (the only USDC spender); the swap OUTPUT is verified by balance delta (the return value is advisory); the USDC allowance is revoked immediately after the swap. Slither rates reentrancy-balance Low impact; the monitor's blanket reentrancy-family rule over-elevates it. Re-verified 2026-09-20.
